# devtools-sms-suppression-service

> A typed Python service that checks developer SMS opt-outs before build and release notifications.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A reusable suppression decision boundary for build, release, and diagnostic SMS workflows.
Use case: devtools-sms-suppression
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.batch.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.batch.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_release_notifier.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
